scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate deploy
